Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the effective date of local fireworks ordinances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to local fireworks ordinances; creating a newsection; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The chief of the Washington state patrol,through the director of fire protection, shall convene a task force toassess whether county and city governments should be authorized, whenadopting ordinances more restrictive than state law, to have theseordinances go into effect sooner than one year after adoption. Thetask force shall consist of four representatives of local fireofficials and four representatives of businesses that sell fireworks inWashington. The director of fire protection shall serve as chair ofthe task force. The task force must submit recommendations to thelegislature by December 1, 2004. This section expires July 1, 2005.
